payload.reason: The evidence clearly identifies KAR as an end-to-end MRC model that utilizes general knowledge to enhance its performance.

claims.text: KAR is an end-to-end MRC model that explicitly uses general knowledge to assist its attention mechanisms.
KAR integrates neural networks with general knowledge to improve its performance compared to state-of-the-art MRC models.
KAR employs a data enrichment method to extract inter-word semantic connections as general knowledge.
